hooks.description: CloudBase template prewarm + Sites preview during credential wait

_comment: LEGACY / OFFLINE FALLBACK only. Prefer marketplace plugin install so hooks/hooks.json auto-merges (stacks with teamai). Replace __PREWARM_PLUGIN_ROOT__ via scripts/render-settings.sh, then APPEND this SessionStart entry into ~/.workbuddy/settings.json — never replace existing teamai hooks. Opt out: CLOUDBASE_WORKBUDDY_PREWARM=0. Skip preview: CLOUDBASE_WORKBUDDY_PREVIEW=0. Template: CLOUDBASE_WORKBUDDY_TEMPLATE=react|vue. Vendored Sites CLI is bundled under vendor/cloudbase-sites; optional CLOUDBASE_SITES_BIN override.
